source: Clearance: standard close-fit / free-fit drill sizes from the common machine-screw clearance chart (e.g. #4: #32 = 0.1160 close, #30 = 0.1285 free); 'normal' = free fit. Tap drill: 75 % thread drill sizes (e.g. #4-40: #43 = 0.0890). Counterbore for socket head cap screws: Machinery's Handbook counterbore table (diameter; depth = head height). Pilot hole for thread-forming screws in plastics: approx. 0.8 d (ABS guideline).
loose_todo: TODO: no loose-fit class in the close/free chart; ASME B18.2.8 defines normal/close/loose clearance holes for inch fasteners and should be added here.

derived.note: Heads without a tabulated counterbore/countersink get dk + 1/32 in x k + 0.01 in, or a countersink of A(theoretical) + 0.01 in at the head angle. Flagged derived=true.
